brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / editorial sports illustration.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball article thumbnail as a PNG, landscape 16:9, ideally 1920x1080, at least 1000 pixels wide.

Article content is a fixed 2026-11-16 19:08 JST snapshot. Its title is 11/16 試合結果（公式記録の確定待ち）. All B.PREMIER and B.ONE game records are still awaiting confirmation. Do not fabricate results, scores, rankings, participation or achievements.

Style: follow the approved black and lime thumbnail visual language visible in the reference: dark charcoal green #151A18, acid lime #CCF43B, ivory white lettering, expressive hand-drawn ink strokes, dry-brush diagonals, limited texture, few elements, very bold readable Japanese display typography. Clearly an illustration, NOT photorealistic, NOT a pasted photograph. Do not copy the old reference's player, text, date or scores.

Subject: draw only ONE real basketball player, David Nwaba / デイビッド・ヌワバ, randomly chosen from the fixed article's 20 named players. Use his viewed official Ryukyu profile photograph solely for likeness reference: short tightly textured black hair, close fade sides, broad forehead, strong deep-set brown eyes, broad nose, full lips, dense full black beard following a squared/rounded jaw and joining the moustache, muscular broad shoulders and arms, medium-dark brown skin. Facial details must remain legible in warm ivory and brown ink highlights, not disappear into black. Plain ivory basketball uniform with dark navy edging, entirely blank with NO team name, NO logo, NO sponsor text, NO jersey number. A plain black compression sleeve on his right arm is acceptable. No additional invented people.

Composition: energetic three-quarter drive pose across the LEFT 45 percent. Nwaba leans forward and drives to the right, one hand visibly controls a single orange basketball near his waist, other arm bends naturally for balance. Face fully visible in three-quarter view, preserve distinctive beard and short haircut. Hands, ball, face and elbows fully within the frame; a deliberate thigh crop at the lower edge is allowed. Anatomically correct two arms and natural five-finger hands. Lime dry-brush arc behind him suggests movement. No arena crowd, no opponent, no scoreboard, no actual game or decisive-shot reenactment. This is a general imagined playing pose.

RIGHT 55 percent: a clean quiet dark type field with generous safe padding and no overlapping player parts. Large typography, compact but well spaced, high contrast. Render only these exact Japanese text lines:
Top small brand: 「バスケまとめ」
Medium heading: 「11/16 試合結果」
Main two-line headline, largest typography:
「公式記録の」
「確定待ち」
The second main line is lime; first is ivory white.
Smaller readable qualification below: 「2026.11.16 19:08時点」
Footer, clearly legible, with adequate margin:
「イラスト（AI生成）」 and 「イメージ」

The waiting-for-confirmation qualifier must be visually dominant, not fine print. No player name anywhere in the artwork. No player statistics, no confirmed participation, no victories, no highlights claims. Avoid English decorative text and all other unrequested text. Do not use '成績をもとにしたイメージ'; use exactly 'イメージ'. No team or league logos, no official photo pixels. Keep all text readable and inside a minimum 5% safe margin. Output one polished image only.
